hypothesis: V18 should keep its noisy high-energy turns, but a pre-entry maturation bar that finishes with a joint CL/MCL adverse close-location and expanding range/volume effort is a distinct auction rejection. Observing exactly the original entry minute before risking capital may separate a recovered retest from an unrecovered fake turn without applying a post-entry stop.

inputs.pre_outcome_correction: The first invocation stopped before writing output because the in-memory effort-floor map used integer keys while the primary lookup used a string. Only that key type was corrected; signal, count, gate, period, and authority semantics are unchanged.

frozen_state_machine.opportunity_set: every exact V18 admission before any changed action
frozen_state_machine.observation_block: the five completed one-minute rows ending one minute before the unchanged V18 entry
frozen_state_machine.closing_rejection: the final maturation minute moves both CL and MCL against V18 direction and closes in the adverse half of both one-minute ranges
effort_channels: CL true range above the causal median of the preceding four maturation minutes
MCL true range above that causal median
CL volume above that causal median
MCL volume above that causal median
frozen_state_machine.primary: closing rejection plus at least three of four effort channels
count_only_neighbours: at least two of four effort channels
frozen_state_machine.recovery: the original entry minute moves both books in V18 direction and closes both in favorable range-halves
frozen_state_machine.projected_action: unflagged V18 entries remain exact; a recovered flag enters one minute late at the next matched-MCL open; an unrecovered flag remains flat until the next ordinary V18 admission

decision_law: Only the three-of-four primary may advance, and only if exact V18 identity plus every cadence, recovered/skipped, direction, branch, lane, and ownership gate passes independently in both periods. Two-of-four and four-of-four are count sensitivity only and cannot replace it. Failure exposes no PnL/MFE/MAE or validation economics.
prohibitions: no effort magnitude, baseline length, close-location band, timing, persistence, or book subset sweep
no direction, branch, lane, ownership, month, or regime rescue
no post-entry abort, reversal, add-on, re-entry, stop, target, timeout, or profit-memory change
no claim that one-minute volume/TR reconstructs sub-minute top-of-book pressure
no live classifier, order, or capital authority
